title: DIS solicitation handling
notes: Implemented Zephyr DIS solicitation admission in new rpl_dis module and wired it into the RPL library. Handler requires authenticated + replay-admitted frames before parsing, evaluates RFC 6550 Solicited Information instance/DODAG/version predicates (absent/no predicates wildcard), resets Trickle for matching multicast requests, returns configured unicast-DIO action for matching unicast, coalesces equivalent requests, globally bounds unicast responses with explicit other-peer rate limiting, and uses wrap-safe deadlines. All parse/duplicate/predicate/rate-limit/Trickle failures preserve handler and timer state. Focused host tests cover auth, replay, malformed/duplicate options, targeted mismatch/match, reserved flags, wildcard behavior, multicast coalescing, unicast rate limiting, exact deadlines, invalid offsets, and uint32 clock wrap: 5/5, CTest 1/1 with UBSan. Scoped Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 rpl_dis.c.obj compiled with SDK 0.16.8. Pinned v3.7 tree unavailable locally per AGENTS.
